title: We build the plumbing that powers your product
description: XXX is a webhook platform that delivers your events reliably, at scale, so your team can focus on building.
story: Reliable event delivery is painful. Retries, ordering, batching, observability, every team ends up building the same broken plumbing by hand. We started XXX so that shipping a webhook to prod is a one-line change, not a months-long project. Our mission is simple: take every delivery headache off your table and turn it into a managed service you never have to think about.

values.title: Reliability first
values.description: Events are lost forever if they don't arrive. We engineer for delivery, not for best case.

values.title: Boring is beautiful
values.description: We keep the stack proven and the guarantees explicit. No surprises when your system depends on us.

values.title: Observable by default
values.description: Every delivery is a first-class citizen you can inspect. If something goes wrong, you'll know exactly where.

values.title: Dogfooding
values.description: We run XXX on YYY. Our own reliability depends on the service we ship to you.
